description: Source code implementing the SwapChain9 class for Direct3D 9 rendering in the ANGLE project, managing swap chain resources, resizing, and presenting frames.

classes.name: SwapChain9
classes.description: A class managing a Direct3D 9 swap chain, including resource management, resizing, and presentation.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases swap chain resources and resets handle if native window exists.

methods.name: convertInterval
methods.description: Converts EGL interval to D3D present interval based on VSYNC configuration.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the swap chain by recreating it with new dimensions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Recreates the swap chain and associated resources with specified dimensions and swap interval.

methods.name: swapRect
methods.description: Performs a swap operation with specified rectangle, rendering a textured quad and presenting.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the current render target surface with reference counting.

methods.name: getDepthStencil
methods.description: Returns the current depth stencil surface with reference counting.

methods.name: getOffscreenTexture
methods.description: Returns the offscreen texture with reference counting.

methods.name: recreate
methods.description: Recreates the swap chain from existing parameters.

methods.name: getColorRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the color render target object.

methods.name: getDepthStencilRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the depth stencil render target object.
